ITEM 1 | White, opaque, crumbly/curd-like mass with soft rounded clumps and irregular edges, matte surface with slight moisture, spread across the upper-left of the plate about 12 cm across and 2-3 cm tall in a loose heap | 150
ITEM 2 | Orange cubes with browned, caramelized edges and some darker charred patches, roughly 2-2.5 cm pieces with slightly glossy, moist-looking surfaces, clustered in the lower-left of the plate covering about 10 cm by 8 cm and 1.5-2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 3 | Assorted whole and halved berries: dark purple-black blackberries with glossy drupelet texture and a few bright red raspberries with soft matte surfaces, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate about 8 cm by 9 cm and 2 cm tall | 85
